title: Solaris
desc: A fintech brand concept spanning identity, campaign imagery and communication layouts.
lead: I developed a fintech identity concept for Solaris around a sunburst mark, warm colour and imagery inspired by light.
body: For Solaris, I explored the visual language of light: a sunburst symbol, orange landscapes and tactile materials. I carried the identity across social layouts, brand cards, staff passes, an app-icon mockup and a billboard concept.
detail: I carried the identity across social layouts, brand cards, staff passes, an app-icon mockup and a billboard concept. The work moves between expressive campaign imagery and simpler white layouts for financial messaging.
captions: Brand world and mobile app icon
contribution: Developed the brand mark, colour direction and typography treatments.
Created a visual direction built around sunlight, glowing forms and dimensional materials.
Explored the identity across campaign, print and digital mockups.
